storeId.description: Stable id for the collaborative feature store (maps to PostGIS table jgis_store_<slug>).

pmtilesPath.description: Path or URL to the static PMTiles baseline snapshot (empty until first fold).

baselineVersion.description: Monotonic baseline / PMTiles version; bump after each fold.

projection.description: CRS for feature coordinates (lon/lat stored as EPSG:4326).

attribution.description: Attribution for the collaborative point source.
